title: Griz Basketball 2025-26 Schedule Unveiled with Heartwarming Twist - NewsBreak
text:
By Ace Sauerwein ,
9 hours ago
The wait is over. We now have the 2025-2026 Montana Grizzlies Men’s Basketball Schedule complete and open to the public.
The schedule is attached below, but scroll down to watch the heartwarming official release video. It features all the coaches’ children and grandchildren reading off the schedule, and it’s adorable.
Plus, we have the all-time records against this year’s opponents.

2025 Montana Grizzlies Schedule, Highlighted By Famous Alumni Famous alumni at each school that the University of Montana Grizzly Football team plays this year. Gallery Credit: Ace Sauerwein Credit: Stephen Dunn (Getty Images) Central Washington: Jon Kitna 14-year NFL quarterback with the Seattle Seahawks, Cincinnati Bengals, Detroit Tigers and Dallas Cowboys. Kitna graduated from Central Washington in 1995. He now coaches Lakota East High School in Ohio. Credit: Stacy Revere (Getty Images) North Dakota: Jonathan Toews 15-year NHL player with the Chicago Blackhawks. Toews was a 3x Stanley Cup Champion and 3x All-Star Credit: Brian Ach (Getty) Indiana State: Larry Bird Indiana State Hall of Famer Larry Bird won the 1978-179 Naismith Award and Wooden Award while leading his Sycamores to the National Championship game. Bird played in the NBA with the Boston Celtics for 13 seasons. Credit: Mat Hayward (Getty) Idaho Vandals: Bill Fagerbakke The voice of Patrick Star in the hit TV show 'SpongeBob SquarePants.' Credit: David Berding (Getty Images) Idaho State Bengals: Jared Allen 12-year NFL career with the Minnesota Vikings, Kansas City Chiefs, Chicago Bears and Carolina Panthers. Allen was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 2025. Credit: Slaven Vlasic (Getty) Cal Poly Mustangs: Weird Al Yankovic Comedian musician, writer, and actor. Best known for his songs 'White & Nerdy' and 'Amish Paradise.' Credit: Kevin Winter (Getty Images) Sacred Heart Pioneers: John Ratzenberger Actor best known for playing Cliff Clavin on 'Cheers." Also a voice actor in several Pixar films like Toy Story, Monsters, Inc. and Cars. Credit: Dia Dipasupil (Getty Images) Sacramento State Hornets: Lester Holt The host of NBC Nightly News Credit: Stacy Revere (Getty) Weber State Wildcats: Damian Lillard 13-year NBA career with the Portland Trail Blazers and Milwaukee Bucks. A 9x All-Star and 7x All-NBA performer Credit: Jane Gershovich (Getty) Eastern Washington Eagles: Cooper Kupp Former National Champion at Eastern Washington, now an 8-year NFL veteran and Super Bowl Champion in 2021 Credit: Stuart C. Wilson (Getty) Portland State Vikings: Courtney Love Singer, songwriter, guitarist, and actress known for forming the band 'Hole.' Credit: Frederick M. Brown Montana State Bobcats: Craig Kilborn Former anchor of ESPN's 'SportsCenter,' former host of 'The Daily Show' and 'The Late Late Show.'
